chatbotContent.welcome:
🌱 **Welcome to CropSaathi AI!** 🌾
Your intelligent farming companion, powered by CropSense.
I’m here to help you make smarter farming decisions with AI-powered crop recommendations, soil health insights, weather outlooks, fertilizer guidance, market prices, and government scheme information.
🌿 **How can I help you today?**
Ask me any farming-related question, and together, let’s work towards healthier crops and better harvests!
**CropSaathi AI — Smarter Farming. Better Harvests.** 💚
chatbotContent.offlineHelp: I can help explain CropSense, this page, and its farming tools. Please try your question again, or explore the relevant section of the website.
chatbotContent.quickFeatures: CropSense brings together soil-based crop rankings, weather context, fertilizer guidance, government scheme information, and report tools. Enter your field details, review recommendations, and use the relevant sections to plan your next steps.
chatbotContent.quickSchemes: Open Schemes & Support to search schemes, review eligibility guidance and document lists, save schemes, track applications, and find crop-loss assistance.
chatbotContent.quickReports: Your results page offers print and PDF options. Email reports go to your registered address; Recommendation History lets you revisit saved results.
chatbotContent.quickResults: The results page shows ranked crop suggestions, your submitted readings, available weather context, fertilizer guidance, schemes, and report actions.

about.smartIntro: Smart Farm Labs is an agricultural technology initiative developing data-driven digital farming tools, with connected and subscription-based services in mind. Our goal is to help farmers make informed decisions, use resources wisely, and support sustainable farming.
about.cropSenseIntro: CropSense is the Smart Farm Labs crop analysis platform. Enter land measurements and a location, explore crop recommendations and seasonal weather insights, and revisit recommendations saved to your private account.
about.teamIntro: A multidisciplinary team brings together platform engineering, product design, sensing systems, and agronomic data.

manoj.focus: Leads the vision, strategy, and technical direction of Smart Farm Labs, driving the development of its smart agriculture initiatives. Founded CropSense and oversees its end-to-end system architecture, AI/ML engineering, backend infrastructure, data integrations, and IoT integration strategy.

abdul.focus: Leads product engineering contributions across full-stack development, API integrations, and farmer-focused interface design, helping translate CropSense's vision into an accessible and reliable agricultural technology platform.

hariharan.focus: Contributes to hardware and agricultural data work, focusing on NPK, soil moisture, soil pH, and DHT22 sensor integration, agricultural dataset curation, and field-data validation to support data-informed farming solutions.
